name: 01_Handle_Lower
description: Battery saddles, board supports, six M3 insert seats. Insert fit requires test coupon.

name: 02_Handle_Upper
description: OLED pod, button opening, six recessed M3 screw channels.

name: 03_Controller_Tray
description: 52 x 28 x 12 mm reference board; strap slots, no fictitious mounting holes.

name: 06_MicroFit_Panel_Insert
description: 2 mm panel with manufacturer-profile opening for Molex 43020-0600. Two M2 screws. Print coupon and check actual connector latches.

name: 07_Filament_Head_Body
description: 102 mm mechanism chamber; servo, 3-position nylon carrier, guide and optical travel gate. Index only with probe fully withdrawn.

name: 08_Filament_Front_Cap
description: Probe guide and TCST2103 mounts. Sensor screw centers 19 mm apart. Front guide removable with two M2 screws.

name: 09_SG90_Strap_Cradle
description: Tie SG90 into open adjustable cradle with two 2.5 mm straps. Align output shaft with X-axis using stock horn; do not print a spline.

name: 11_Vibration_Dome_Cap
description: Adafruit 1201 coin motor (10 x 2.7 mm), adhesive retained. Prototype dome must be physically assessed for vibration transfer.

name: 12_Button_Cap
description: 0.3 mm nominal switch gap; set final switch height with thin shims.

name: 13_Fastener_Fit_Coupon
description: Left to right: 3.2 / 3.4 / 3.9 / 4.1 mm bores. Use before full enclosure print.

name: 14_Handle_Wire_Clamp
description: M2 screw clamp over 4.8 mm bore; 4.2 mm diameter bundle reserve. Optional soft liner adapted to the real wires.

name: 15_Head_Joint_Test_Male
description: Exact pilot and key geometry from both heads. Use with each female fit coupon.

name: 16_Head_Joint_Test_Female_24
description: Radial clearance 0.25 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

name: 17_Head_Joint_Test_Female_35
description: Radial clearance 0.35 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

name: 18_Head_Joint_Test_Female_44
description: Radial clearance 0.45 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

name: 19_MicroFit_Panel_Test
description: Actual 2 mm connector insert rotated flat, for checking the connector snap-in fit before printing housing.

name: 20_Boost_Shelf
description: U3V40F5 strap platform. Four M2 screws into SD shelf columns; remove for SD access.

name: 21_Three_Position_Carrier
description: Three cartridge pockets spaced 60 degrees on R10. Carrier travel -60 / 0 / +60 degrees. Stock SG90 horn in rear pocket, two M2 screws in radial slots.

name: 22_Nylon_Insert_1
description: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

name: 23_Nylon_Insert_2
description: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

name: 24_Nylon_Insert_3
description: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

name: 25_Insert_Retainer
description: Two M2 screws at Y +/-14, Z5 retain the three potted inserts without clamping the free nylon.

name: 26_Probe_Rear_Pad_and_Flag
description: Low-mass pad with integral optical flag. Bond onto 3 mm polished shaft; 1 mm initial gap. No return spring: pull tip collar to fully extend before indexing.

name: 27_Probe_Guide
description: Seat for PTFE tube OD4/ID3.2, length7.5. Two M2 screws hold flange. Fit must slide freely; measure breakaway force.

name: 28_Probe_Tip
description: Removable prototype contact tip; bond to rod. Guide flange gives 6 mm travel stop. Bench use pending surface and force verification.

name: 29_Button_Platform
description: 6 mm tactile switch mounted centrally. Two M2 mounting screws. Shim switch to give 0.3 mm cap travel.

name: 30_OLED_Retainer
description: Rear retaining frame with thin foam/adhesive at PCB corners. Remove upper shell as a module with display, frame and button cap.

name: 31_Battery_Protection_Tray
description: Strap or adhesive mount for 1S protection board, 16 x 12 x 5 max. Specify at least 5 A discharge rating; physical sample required.

name: REF_Power_Slide_Switch
description: SS12D00G3-style slide switch envelope. Adhesive retained under heel slot. Switch EN only, not servo supply current.

name: REF_MicroFit_Mated_24p77
description: Combined packaging envelope based on Molex drawings, not manufacturer solid CAD. 43020-0600 + 43025-0600, 24.77 mm mated length. Six 24 AWG wires, max insulation OD1.3 mm; service-loop connection. See wiring.md for pin assignments and terminal options.

name: REF_Pololu_U3V40F5
description: Pololu 4012 U3V40F5 boost regulator, headerless 15.24 x 15.24 x 5.6 mm. Validate servo transient load, not a 4 A output claim.

name: REF_Vibration_Driver_Reserve_6x20x10
description: Custom 20 x 10 x 6 max perfboard: AO3400A MOSFET, flyback diode, gate resistor and pull-down. Mount in head with adhesive pad; 5 V supply.

name: REF_Stock_Horn
description: Stock two-arm horn envelope: trim outer length to 27 mm if needed; preserve spline, center screw and mounting holes.
